::: {.why}
Depth decides what a trade costs and resiliency decides how long that cost lasts, and both are measurable from the reconstruction you built yesterday.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Report the depth profile as a function of distance from the mid, and how it varies through the session.
- Measure resiliency as the time for depth to recover after a large trade, and give a number.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Build the depth profile: average displayed size against distance from the mid in ticks, computed separately for the first thirty minutes, the middle of the day and the last thirty minutes. The intraday pattern is strong and it explains why execution algorithms trade the way they do.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Measure resiliency: find the largest trades of the day, and for each plot the depth at the touch in the seconds before and after. Report the median recovery half-life. That number is what decides whether splitting an order into ten pieces one second apart is different from doing it all at once.
:::
:::
